name: Swift
criteria: Expressive compiled language with enums + switch pattern matching, value-type structs, Set/Dictionary and closures-based map/filter/reduce; nice for modelling records and custom Comparable sorts. String indexing is clumsy, so parse via split or Array(utf8).
build: mkdir -p .build && for p in $AOC_PART; do [ .build/p$p -nt Part$p.swift ] && [ .build/p$p -nt Aoc.swift ] && [ .build/p$p -nt main.swift ] || swiftc -O -swift-version 6 -module-cache-path .build/cache main.swift Aoc.swift Part$p.swift -o .build/p$p || exit 1; done
